description.value: Lunch Lady is a celebrated Vietnamese street food restaurant on Vancouver's Commercial Drive, rooted in the legacy of Saigon legend Mrs. Nguyen Thi Thanh, whose rotating noodle soups earned her global fame including a feature by Anthony Bourdain. The Vancouver kitchen marries Pacific Northwest ingredients with Chef Nguyen's Vietnamese mastery in an award-winning menu designed by Chef Benedict Lim. With both indoor and outdoor seating on one of Vancouver's most vibrant cycling corridors, it is a notable dining destination for touring cyclists passing through the east side.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 21m; rack at 93m. Total: 4 spaces.
